calls.statement:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS qs, period_end_date AS qe FROM (
    SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, min(period_start_date) period_start_date, max(period_end_date) period_end_date
    FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2)
),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id <> 999),
sales AS (
  SELECT q.fiscal_year, c.region, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN q ON f.sale_date BETWEEN q.qs AND q.qe),
rets AS (
  SELECT q.fiscal_year, c.region, s.store_id, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN q ON r.return_date BETWEEN q.qs AND q.qe),
u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets),
agg AS (
  SELECT region, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN amt END) AS last_year, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN amt END) AS prior_year FROM u GROUP BY 1)
SELECT region, round(last_year,2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26_q3, round(prior_year,2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25_q3, round(100*(last_year/prior_year-1),1) AS growth_pct FROM agg ORDER BY CASE region WHEN 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, region

WITH a AS (SELECT CASE WHEN business_date>='2025-10-27' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'PY' END y, store_id=900 web, sum(net_sales) ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25' OR business_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26' GROUP BY ALL),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date>='2025-10-27' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'PY' END y, s.store_id=900 web, sum(net_amount) gross, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN net_amount END) trn FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-10-27' AND '2026-01-25' OR sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-01-26' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT * FROM a JOIN b USING(y,web) ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, min(period_start_date) AS qs, max(period_end_date) AS qe
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY fiscal_year),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE region END AS region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id <> 999),
u AS (
  SELECT q.fiscal_year, c.region, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN q ON f.sale_date BETWEEN q.qs AND q.qe
  UNION ALL
  SELECT q.fiscal_year, c.region, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN q ON r.return_date BETWEEN q.qs AND q.qe),
agg AS (SELECT region, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN amt END) AS ly, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN amt END) AS py FROM u GROUP BY region)
SELECT region, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, round(ly,2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, round(py,2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, round(100*(ly/py-1),2) AS growth_pct
FROM agg ORDER BY CASE region WHEN 'Web shop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, region
